item.title: Parkland shooting: Battle over Florida gun laws continues eight years after 17 killed
item.description: Saturday marks eight years since the Parkland shooting, which left 17 people dead at Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School in Broward County. Since then, Florida has beefed up school security and changed gun laws, but some of the family members of the victims are still deep in fights over proposed changes.
